name: codealpha-project-management-tool
description: Collaborative project management tool (Trello/Asana-style) with real-time boards, task assignment, comments and notifications.

comments.scripts: These call tsc/vite/tsx directly rather than `npm run -w <workspace>`: a nested workspace `npm run` inside a script silently discards the rest of an && chain, which quietly broke both build and dev.

scripts.build: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && vite build --config client/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
